name: Ded's API
description: The tiny shared library behind Ded811's revival mods. Each of them routes its Minecraft and mod-loader plumbing through this one jar, so a single API update keeps every mod working on a new game version. Deliberately minimal (a few dozen small classes) - it adds no blocks, no items, no game content and no measurable overhead. Mods that need it usually bundle it, so there is normally nothing to install separately.
